newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse turns down after corporate tax plan.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse turns down after corporate tax plan.

text.p: French shares fell by some 0.6 percent after the government spokeswoman confirmed the Socialist cabinet was studying new taxes on companies. The market had been cutting its record gains before the announcement. Downturn mainly fuelled by options and futures market.
"Sure it is negative for the market but it is not a big surprise. I see our options people shouting down the phone but I do not understand this fall," a broker said.
* CAC-40 index down 16.13, or 0.59 percent, at 2,927.91 at 1025 GMT. All time high set at 2,986.09.
* CAC-40 July futures 2,930 vs 2,945 at Tuesdays close.
